threads.subject: Delivering two parcels in one turn

posts.author: RulesGuide
posts.body: A courier may deliver both parcels when both destination symbols match the current station.

posts.author: ExamplePlayer
posts.body: The movement cost is paid once before resolving either delivery.

faq.text:
## Deliveries

**Q:** Can two parcels be delivered in one turn?

**A:** Yes, when both symbols match the station. Pay movement once, then resolve both parcels. [Example source](https://example.invalid/starlight/thread/101#post-a)

posts.author: DemoDesigner
posts.body: Harvesting ends that worker's action, so watering must be performed by another worker.

faq.text:
## Worker actions

**Q:** Can the same worker water after harvesting?

**A:** No. Harvesting ends that worker's action. [Example source](https://example.invalid/orchard/thread/202#post-a)

posts.author: IslandKeeper
posts.body: Each tied player receives the full lighthouse value; the points are not divided.

faq.text:
## Scoring

**Q:** Are shared lighthouse points divided?

**A:** No. Every tied player receives the full value. [Example source](https://example.invalid/tides/thread/303#post-a)
